name: Concrete Flatwork
shortDescription: New pours for driveways, patios, sidewalks, and slabs.
longDescription: Standard 4" residential concrete flatwork with proper base prep, wire mesh or rebar reinforcement, and a broom finish. Thicker slabs, decorative finishes, and heavy vehicle-rated driveways run higher than the base range.

name: Pressure Washing
shortDescription: Driveways, patios, sidewalks, and other concrete surfaces.
longDescription: Surface cleaning for concrete driveways, patios, and walkways. Heavy oil staining, mold, or gravel/paver surfaces may cost more than a standard clean concrete slab.

name: Concrete Sealing
shortDescription: Protective acrylic or epoxy sealant for concrete driveways and patios.
longDescription: Cleaning and sealing of existing concrete surfaces to protect against water, oil, and UV damage. Assumes surface is in serviceable condition — significant crack repair is quoted separately.

name: Asphalt Driveway Sealing
shortDescription: Sealcoating for asphalt driveways, including basic crack fill.
longDescription: Cleaning, basic crack filling, and sealcoat application for asphalt driveways. Extensive fill-and-seal repair for badly deteriorated asphalt is quoted after inspection.

name: Hardscaping
shortDescription: Paver patios, walkways, and other hardscape installs.
longDescription: Installed paver patios and walkways, including excavation, base prep, and edge restraint. Entry-tier pricing for standard pavers on flat, accessible ground — premium materials, steps, or difficult access increase cost.

name: Retaining Walls
shortDescription: Segmental block retaining walls under 4 ft.
longDescription: Segmental block retaining wall construction, walls under 4 ft in height (no engineering required). Height, soil conditions, drainage needs, and access can move price well outside this range — a site visit is required before any firm number.
unitLabel: square feet of wall face (length × height)

name: Erosion Control
shortDescription: Silt fencing, slope stabilization, grading, and matting.
longDescription: Covers silt fence and erosion matting installed by the linear foot, or slope grading with seed/mulch stabilization priced by the square foot. Soil type, slope grade, and drainage patterns vary enormously — this range is a starting point only, and a site visit is required.

name: Snow Removal
shortDescription: Per-visit or seasonal contract driveway & walkway clearing.
longDescription: Residential driveway and walkway clearing. Choose per-visit pricing for occasional storms or a flat seasonal contract for unlimited visits November through March. Steep, gravel, or unusually large driveways may run above this range.
